evals.name: sanctions-causal-refinement
evals.prompt: Radar says a new sanctions package removed 60 tankers and should immediately increase tanker rates. Research this with confidence and decide whether the lead should advance.
evals.expected_output: Reconstructs what the 60 count includes; traces the original sanctions document; separates direct vessel removals from ecosystem effects; tests whether rates were already moving because of conflict, insurance, rerouting, or other confounders; provides a counterfactual; may refine the thesis toward duration rather than immediate magnitude; separates mechanism confidence from security-mispricing confidence; hands off an exact reverse-underwriting question or rejects/waits.

evals.name: expert-claim-independent-check
evals.prompt: An industry expert says one AI lab earns $50 million of revenue per inference megawatt and will absorb half of incremental global compute next year. Validate the claim and identify investable read-throughs without using my portfolio context.
evals.expected_output: Does not load broad personal context; separates the exact numerical claims; identifies missing denominators and attribution rules; triangulates with contracts, capacity, revenue, and supplier evidence; gives different confidence levels for direction versus exact figures; maps direct, second-order, and false-friend beneficiaries; routes valuation questions to Full Underwriting rather than making an unsupported buy call.

evals.name: clinical-approval-expectations
evals.prompt: A biotech received an expected FDA approval and a $250 million milestone. The stock had risen 30% before the PDUFA. Determine what is actually new and whether the lead deserves underwriting.
evals.expected_output: Uses the clinical/biotech overlay; compares the label, efficacy, safety, commercial rights, milestone, royalties, cash runway, and pre-event expectations; does not treat the milestone as a surprise merely because it became cash; checks ownership claims and possible double-counting; separates clinical, commercial, capture, and mispricing confidence; produces a clear advance/wait/monitor/reject decision and exact underwriting question.

evals.name: short-duration-event-routing
evals.prompt: A court ruling on a merger is due tomorrow. I only want to hold the trade for a few days. The factual antitrust record is disputed, the spread is 10%, and rejection downside may be 30%. Research the claim and tell me the correct next gate.
evals.expected_output: Independently verifies the legal and transaction facts, source origins, timing and competing interpretations; separates factual confidence from tradeability; does not perform an incomplete event-payoff analysis inside RWC; routes to Event-Trade Underwriting only if the discrete-event facts survive and the user explicitly wants the short horizon; otherwise waits for named evidence or rejects; hands off the exact event, information cutoff, disputed facts, possible states, and missing execution or payoff inputs.
